description: Development-only reference metadata and compatibility strings. Historical keys, paths, URLs and scientific descriptions retain their exact values. Not loaded by the Rust engine.

texts.analyze_iir_rating.interpretation: Predeclared conditional confirmation at independently previously selected reference2300. Local logistic benchmark model; family bootstrap does not measure opponent-dial calibration error or transfer to other controls. Rating attaches only to this matched candidate. Public Elo and full-strength Stockfish superiority remain unestablished.
texts.analyze_rating.interpretation: Family bootstrap addresses opening dependence, not opponent-dial calibration error or generalization to other controls. Experimental proof/conversion scoring and production 0.6 are not rated by this result. Goal of surpassing full-strength Stockfish remains unachieved.
texts.analyze_rust_foundation.interpretation: Predeclared local screen, not an absolute/public Elo, not a universal Stockfish-superiority test. Family resampling is limited by the number and distribution of sampled families.
texts.assess_capacity.interpretation: Predeclared nested hidden-capacity ablation. No Elo or Stockfish superiority inferred; any failed gate keeps the candidate experimental.
texts.assess_deep_turn.interpretation: Predeclared fresh paired-turn objective ablation. No Elo or Stockfish superiority inferred; any failed gate keeps the candidate experimental.
texts.assess_iir.interpretation: Predeclared paired strength-regression qualification. A positive result here is bounded to this baseline, controls and opening selection; not Stockfish superiority or a public Elo.
texts.assess_lazy_order.interpretation: Engineering optimization decision using explicitly amended baseline fact before matches/timing. Not proof of Elo gain or full-strength Stockfish superiority. All results and failures retained; no adaptive retuning.
texts.assess_phase.interpretation: Predeclared architecture screen only. No Elo inferred and no Stockfish superiority. Failed tactics or confidence gates keep the neural model experimental; classical default retained.
texts.assess_q_evasion.interpretation: Engineering optimization qualification under declared independent correctness, same-work, speed and equal-time regression gates. Not proof of Elo gain or full-strength Stockfish superiority.
texts.assess_relations.interpretation: Predeclared geometric relation feature ablation. No Elo or Stockfish superiority inferred; any failed gate keeps the candidate experimental.
texts.assess_stable_endgames.interpretation: Predeclared teacher-label ablation. No Elo or Stockfish superiority inferred; any failed gate keeps the candidate experimental.
texts.check_mate_proof.interpretation: New native general certificate interface passes independent strategy/protocol checks. Pinned Stockfish does not natively return this explanation command; external tools can add such functionality. Exact normal playing outputs retained, not a strength improvement claim.
texts.declare_capacity.interpretation: Same finite-label and endgame-biased source and historical static/deep mix. More capacity may worsen search cost; matched epoch count is not equal training compute. Extra units start zero-output, so initial function matches but optimization geometry differs. Teacher fit, timing and tactical gains do not establish Stockfish superiority.
texts.declare_deep_turn.interpretation: Same finite-label selection and endgame-biased parent source; counterfactual states are not played outcomes or retrograde reachability proofs. Labels are not oracles. Neither distillation nor this ablation establishes Stockfish superiority.
texts.declare_iir.interpretation: Always complete640 regression games, even failed tactics. Conditional256 rating games only if frozen promotion gates pass. Preserve every result, binary/source, options/control/openings/hardware/PGN/audit. No retuning after outcomes. Full-strength Stockfish superiority remains unachieved.
texts.declare_mate_proof.capability: Original exhaustive bounded AND/OR mate search, any standard-chess material, independent rules-only certificate verification. One legal attacker continuation, every legal defense, every leaf actual mate. No Stockfish/table runtime dependency.
texts.declare_mate_proof.success: Independent general certificates and all correctness/protocol/unchanged-playing gates. Budgets may produce unproven results, never guarantees. Native capability expansion is distinct from unachieved full-strength Stockfish playing superiority.
texts.declare_phase.interpretation: One initialization and existing development data isolate architecture, not broad endgame generalization. Broader stable endgame supervision is a separate subsequent experiment. Stockfish superiority unachieved.
texts.declare_relations.interpretation: Relations are geometric and aggregate: no legal-capture or tactical oracle. More expensive inference may outweigh fit gains. Equal epochs are not equal compute. No promotion on fit/speed/tactics alone; all prior playing gates retained. Full Stockfish superiority and public Elo remain unestablished.
texts.declare_stable_endgames.interpretation: Single seed, bounded endgame-biased teacher play and finite-label selection. Labels/outcomes are not oracles. Distillation and native certificates do not establish exceeding full-strength Stockfish.
texts.freeze_rust.interpretation: Compressed weights are reproducibly fetched from the immutable URL and SHA-256-checked by build.rs. The standalone binary embeds them. Fingerprints below preserve source, Cargo dependency lock, model/license pin and build scripts. No Elo or Stockfish superiority inferred.

Core search/evaluation unchanged; 66 fixed-node outputs agree. No claim about third-party Stockfish interfaces or general chess intelligence.
